item.title: Palo Alto CEO Warns AI Is Cracking Human-Proof Vulnerabilities
item.description:
Palo Alto Networks CEO Nikesh Arora says AI can now crack vulnerabilities previously deemed uncrackable by humans, citing Anthropic's Mythos surfacing 50 years of coding mistakes in a very short span. He estimates 12 to 18 months to remediate the legacy flaws, calling it open season for attackers, with a single actor already using agents against 19 companies at once.

原文标题：Palo Alto CEO 警告 AI 正攻破人类难解漏洞

Why it matters：头部安全厂商掌门人给出 AI 攻破历史漏洞的具体时间窗口与攻击面变化，对安全与 AI 从业者具直接参考价值。

item.title: Musk Says AI and Robots Will Demand Far More Bandwidth Than Humans
item.description:
Elon Musk argued in an interview that future bandwidth demand will be driven mainly by superintelligence and robots, which could communicate at trillions of bits per second versus roughly 100 bits per second for peak human speech. The claim points to long-term expansion of compute and network infrastructure but remains a qualitative forecast without technical detail or supporting data.

Why it matters：马斯克对 AI 与机器人通信带宽需求给出量级判断，涉及算力网络基础设施的长期走向，值得关注但缺乏可验证细节。

item.title: Audit Finds MiniMax Opened Private Links Hidden in User Prompts
item.description:
US security firm Dragos planted trap links and fake logins in nearly 2 million prompts sent to multiple AI services to test whether providers secretly read or passed on customer data. Only links in prompts routed to MiniMax's servers were opened days later by unknown parties, even when users had requested no storage; after the scraping appeared to stop on October 22, a git client tried to clone private code repositories referenced in MiniMax-bound prompts. MiniMax says its security system automatically collected and opened links for threat detection without retaining full content, while Atlas Cloud stopped forwarding requests to MiniMax and OpenRouter removed three providers and tightened its data privacy rules.

原文标题：安全审计曝 MiniMax 私自打开用户提示词中的私密链接

Why it matters：第三方安全审计直指大模型服务商的数据处理边界，并已引发下游平台断供与隐私规则收紧，对评估 API 供应商风险有直接参考价值。

item.title: Nscale Says It Has Enough Capital to Delay $35B IPO
item.description:
Nscale CEO Josh Payne told staff the UK data centre operator has enough capital to stay private, casting doubt on its planned $35B IPO and promising only to list as soon as possible. The company expects a net loss of nearly $1.7B for the nine months to September on revenue of just $307M, and says it will need additional financing in 2027. Listed peers CoreWeave and Nebius fell 24% and 43% in a month, signaling a poor market window.

原文标题：Nscale 称资金充足暂缓 350 亿美元 IPO

Why it matters：AI 算力基础设施大额 IPO 生变，叠加巨额亏损与同业估值回调，是观察算力泡沫与融资环境的关键信号。

item.title: Ladybird Browser Ships First Alpha With Fully In-House Engine
item.description:
After four years of building a browser engine from scratch, the Ladybird project released its first downloadable alpha on November 23, offering prebuilt macOS and Linux packages with automatic updates instead of requiring users to compile from source. Both its rendering engine and LibJS JavaScript engine are written from the ground up rather than forked from Blink or Gecko.

item.title: JetBrains Survey of 29,000 Developers Finds 96% Use AI at Work
item.description:
JetBrains' tenth annual Developer Ecosystem report, based on 28,945 developers worldwide, finds 96% of employed developers use at least one AI tool at work, with 55% reporting higher creativity but 46% feeling less ownership of code. Claude Code leads tool usage at 39%, ahead of GitHub Copilot at 21%, and over half of coding-agent users say agents handled more than 60% of their development tasks last month.

item.title: SpaceX StarBase Data Center Takes Shape in Under 90 Days
item.description:

The project carries over $24 billion in investment and pairs with a 750 MW on-site natural gas plant, whose air permit was issued by the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality on November 16.

item.title: Twenty AI Agents Team Up to Cut Quickwit Hot Query Time 31%
item.description:
TabbyML deployed a team of 20 AI agents as autonomous systems engineers on the open-source search engine Quickwit, letting them locate bottlenecks, propose designs, run experiments and review each other's code without line-level human direction. In four days the team ran roughly 350 experiments and kept 6 reviewed optimizations, cutting total hot-query time on a 100M-row dataset from 40.5s to 27.9s (down 31%, up to 87% on some queries) and surpassing all prior public results in the ClickBench data-lake hot-query ranking.

原文标题：20 个 AI Agents 组队 4 天优化 Quickwit 热查询降 31%

Why it matters：这是多智能体自主完成真实系统性能工程的少见公开实证，含完整基准数据与可复现方法。

item.title: Tencent Hunyuan Releases Hy3D 3.6 3D Generation Model
item.description:
Tencent Hunyuan has released Hy3D 3.6, a new-generation 3D generation model focused on high-poly modeling and PBR texture generation for professional creators such as artists, modelers, and technical artists. The native 3D model compresses geometry and texture into a unified sparse latent representation via VAE, then uses a DiT to generate assets matching reference images, supported by an agile evaluation and data engine iteration pipeline. It is available through the Hunyuan 3D creation engine and Tencent Cloud API.

item.title: Embodied AI Firms Shift R&D Focus to Low-Level Motion Control
item.description:
At a roundtable during BAAI's REAL Physical AI Open Day, founders from leading embodied AI startups including Spirit AI, Galbot, Galaxea, and Robot Era agreed that as general-purpose models like GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.2 outperform specialized robot models in task planning (System 2), embodied firms should redirect R&D priority toward motion control and skill execution (System 0/1). Galbot's Wang He noted that pure agent methods can score high on simulation benchmarks but still face hard gaps in on-device deployment and real physical execution. Founders also warned of cooling capital and a narrowing startup window.

原文标题：具身智能公司集体转向 优先投入底层运控

item.title: 微软新研究揭示 AI 编程补丁体积达人类 2.33 倍
item.description:
